title: 5th Circuit blocks Texas law requiring websites to filter "harmful" speech
summary: Texas cannot enforce a law’s requirement that websites block minors from seeing harmful speech, the US Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit ruled on Friday. 5th Circuit judges didn’t buy Paxton’s argument.
